STEP 3 - Items: one whole red-yellow apple (looks like a Pink Lady or Fuji). There is no sauce or other food.

STEP 6 - Grams: an apple's density is about 0.8 g/ml, which gives about 240 g. That is a bit heavy for an apple of this size, and the diameter estimate may run slightly high, so I use about 200 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: apple with skin is about 52 kcal/100 g, so 200 g gives about 104 kcal.
